---
title: "Virome library — Figure 1A"
author: ""
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

## Overview

Three-panel figure reproducing the Seo et al. 2023 *Cell* Fig. 1A layout.

| Panel | X axis | Bar layers |
|-------|--------|------------|
| 1 | Accession count | Light grey = NCBI RefSeq total; dark grey = RppH-only input (≥1 R rep); colour = Xrn1 detected (≥ `MIN_REPS` passing) |
| 2 | Feature length (nt) | 3′UTR (orange) + intergenic (blue) boxplots |
| 3 | Accessions detected | Stacked: 2 vs 3 replicates passing |

**Sample identity:**

- **R1 / R2 / R3** = RppH-only = **no Xrn1 degradation** = input / control
- **X1 / X2 / X3** = Xrn1 treatment = **degradation** = experimental output

**Detection logic:**  
The peaks xlsx has one row per tile. A tile passes in a replicate
(`peak_pass_RN == TRUE`) when: `treated_sf ≥ 0.3`, `ctrl_sf ≤ 0.1`,
`fold_change ≥ 3`, `stall_reads ≥ 10`, `qvalue ≤ 0.01`.  
`n_reps_passing` counts replicates where the tile passes all criteria.  
An accession is **detected** if it has at least one tile with
`n_reps_passing >= MIN_REPS`. Each accession is counted **once**
(best tile by `n_reps_passing`).  
The xlsx used here has cutoffs manually verified and applied.

**Alignment:** BAM files from `04_align/fs4`
(`20260312_viromelib_150x0_fs4-prev`).  
**Presence CSV** generated by `scripts/accession_presence_by_sample.py`.  
**NCBI counts** generated by `scripts/fetch_ncbi_family_counts.py`.

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(glue)
library(cowplot)
library(readxl)
library(svglite)   # install.packages("svglite") if needed

# ── Config ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
INPUT_DIR     <- "~/Desktop/viromelib/figures/fig1/inputs"

FASTA_FILE    <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "pilot_library_20260319.uniqueIDs.fa")
CSV_FILE      <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "virus_stats.csv")
PRESENCE_FILE <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "accession_presence_by_sample20260820.csv")
PEAKS_FILE    <- file.path(INPUT_DIR,
                  "123_peaks_annotated20260721-apply-cutoffs20260824.xlsx")
NCBI_FILE     <- file.path(INPUT_DIR, "ncbi_family_counts.csv")

OUT_DIR       <- "~/Desktop/viromelib/figures/fig1/plots/20260824"
OUT_PDF       <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig1a_style.pdf")
OUT_SVG       <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig1a_style.svg")
OUT_CSV       <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "virome_summary.csv")
OUT_DET       <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "detection_summary.csv")
OUT_QC        <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "fig1a_qc_checks.txt")

MIN_REPS     <- 2      # n_reps_passing threshold to call detected
MIN_LEN      <- 100    # minimum feature length (nt) for Panel 2
BAR_WIDTH    <- 0.7
POINT_ALPHA  <- 0.35
FIGURE_W     <- 14
FIGURE_H     <- 8.5
```

---

## 1. Parse FASTA — feature lengths

```{r parse_fasta}
lines   <- readLines(FASTA_FILE)
headers <- sub("^>", "", lines[startsWith(lines, ">")])
rx      <- "^([^|]+)\\|(\\d+)-(\\d+)_(.+)$"
matched <- regmatches(headers, regexec(rx, headers))

parse_one <- function(m) {
  if (length(m) < 5) return(NULL)
  data.frame(acc_clean = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", m[2]),
             length    = as.integer(m[4]) - as.integer(m[3]),
             feature   = m[5], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
fasta_df <- bind_rows(lapply(matched, parse_one))

utr_df <- fasta_df %>%
  filter(grepl("3UTR", feature, ignore.case = TRUE), length >= MIN_LEN) %>%
  select(acc_clean, length)

ig_df <- fasta_df %>%
  filter(grepl("intergenic", feature, ignore.case = TRUE), length >= MIN_LEN) %>%
  select(acc_clean, length)

message(glue("{nrow(utr_df)} 3'UTR | {nrow(ig_df)} intergenic >= {MIN_LEN} nt"))
```

## 2. Taxonomy

```{r taxonomy}
artifact_phyla <- c("Macronovirus", "Tobacco albetovirus 3")

tax_df <- read_csv(CSV_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename_with(tolower) %>%
  mutate(
    acc_clean = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", accession),
    phylum    = if_else(phylum %in% artifact_phyla | is.na(phylum) |
                          phylum == "Unannotated", "Unannotated", phylum),
    family    = if_else(is.na(family) | family == "Unannotated",
                        "Unannotated", family)
  )
```

## 3. NCBI RefSeq totals (outermost grey bar)

```{r ncbi}
ncbi_counts <- read_csv(NCBI_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(n_ncbi = ncbi_total) %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_ncbi), n_ncbi > 0)

message(glue("{nrow(ncbi_counts)} families with NCBI RefSeq counts"))
```

## 4. Input — RppH-only accessions (R replicates)

```{r input}
presence <- read_csv(PRESENCE_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    acc_clean  = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", accession),
    in_r_input = R1 | R2 | R3,
    in_x_exp   = X1 | X2 | X3
  )

input_accs <- presence %>% filter(in_r_input) %>% pull(acc_clean)

input_counts <- tibble(acc_clean = input_accs) %>%
  inner_join(tax_df, by = "acc_clean") %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(
    n_input = n_distinct(acc_clean),
    phylum  = names(sort(table(phylum), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

### ✅ Sanity check — input presence

```{r sanity_input}
presence_summary <- presence %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(
    in_r_input & in_x_exp  ~ "R and X (both)",
    in_r_input & !in_x_exp ~ "R only (input, not in Xrn1)",
    !in_r_input & in_x_exp ~ "X only (Xrn1, not in input)",
    TRUE                    ~ "Neither"
  )) %>%
  count(category)
print(presence_summary)

rep_counts <- presence %>%
  summarise(across(c(R1, R2, R3, X1, X2, X3), sum))
print(rep_counts)

stopifnot(
  "Input accession count mismatch" =
    length(input_accs) == sum(presence$in_r_input)
)
message(glue("✅ Input: {length(input_accs)} accessions in >= 1 R replicate"))
```

---

## 5. Output — detected accessions (≥ MIN_REPS passing)

```{r load_peaks}
# Read xlsx — cutoffs already manually verified and applied
peaks_raw <- read_excel(PEAKS_FILE, sheet = "123_peaks_annotated") %>%
  mutate(
    acc_clean      = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", sub("\\|.*", "", accession)),
    family         = if_else(is.na(family) | family == "Unannotated",
                             "Unannotated", family),
    n_reps_passing = as.integer(n_reps_passing),
    peak_pass_R1   = as.logical(peak_pass_R1),
    peak_pass_R2   = as.logical(peak_pass_R2),
    peak_pass_R3   = as.logical(peak_pass_R3),
    treated_sf_R1  = as.numeric(treated_sf_R1),
    treated_sf_R2  = as.numeric(treated_sf_R2),
    treated_sf_R3  = as.numeric(treated_sf_R3),
    qvalue_R1      = as.numeric(qvalue_R1),
    qvalue_R2      = as.numeric(qvalue_R2),
    qvalue_R3      = as.numeric(qvalue_R3)
  )

message(glue("Total tiles in peaks file: {nrow(peaks_raw)}"))
message("n_reps_passing distribution:")
print(table(peaks_raw$n_reps_passing, useNA = "ifany"))
```

```{r filter_peaks}
# Step 1: filter to tiles with enough passing replicates
passing_tiles <- peaks_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_reps_passing), n_reps_passing >= MIN_REPS)

message(glue("{nrow(passing_tiles)} tiles with n_reps_passing >= {MIN_REPS}"))

# Step 2: one row per accession — best tile (highest n_reps_passing)
# This ensures each accession is counted exactly once
det_accs <- passing_tiles %>%
  group_by(family, acc_clean) %>%
  slice_max(n_reps_passing, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

message(glue(
  "{nrow(det_accs)} unique accessions detected | ",
  "{n_distinct(det_accs$family)} families"
))

# Step 3: summarise per family x replicate count
det_summary <- det_accs %>%
  mutate(rep_label = factor(n_reps_passing, levels = c(2, 3),
                            labels = c("2 replicates", "3 replicates"))) %>%
  group_by(family, rep_label) %>%
  summarise(n_accs = n(), .groups = "drop")

output_counts <- det_summary %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  summarise(n_output = sum(n_accs), .groups = "drop")

det_wide <- det_summary %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = rep_label, values_from = n_accs, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(total_detected = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric))))
write_csv(det_wide, OUT_DET)
```

### ✅ Sanity check — filter thresholds

```{r sanity_filter}
# Check treated_sf and qvalue only in replicates that passed,
# using the best tile per accession
all_tsf <- c(
  det_accs$treated_sf_R1[which(det_accs$peak_pass_R1)],
  det_accs$treated_sf_R2[which(det_accs$peak_pass_R2)],
  det_accs$treated_sf_R3[which(det_accs$peak_pass_R3)]
) %>% na.omit()

all_qval <- c(
  det_accs$qvalue_R1[which(det_accs$peak_pass_R1)],
  det_accs$qvalue_R2[which(det_accs$peak_pass_R2)],
  det_accs$qvalue_R3[which(det_accs$peak_pass_R3)]
) %>% na.omit()

message(glue(
  "treated_sf in passing reps (best tile per accession): ",
  "{round(min(all_tsf), 4)} \u2013 {round(max(all_tsf), 4)}"
))
message(glue(
  "qvalue in passing reps (best tile per accession): ",
  "{signif(min(all_qval), 3)} \u2013 {signif(max(all_qval), 3)}"
))

stopifnot(
  "treated_sf below 0.3 in passing replicates" = min(all_tsf) >= 0.3,
  "qvalue above 0.01 in passing replicates"    = max(all_qval) <= 0.01
)
message("✅ Filter verified: treated_sf >= 0.3 and qvalue <= 0.01 in all passing replicates")
```

## 6. Combined family summary

```{r family_summary}
family_sum <- input_counts %>%
  left_join(ncbi_counts, by = "family") %>%
  left_join(output_counts, by = "family") %>%
  replace_na(list(n_output = 0)) %>%
  mutate(n_ncbi_capped = pmax(n_ncbi, n_input, na.rm = TRUE))

write_csv(family_sum, OUT_CSV)
n_phyla <- n_distinct(family_sum$phylum[family_sum$phylum != "Unannotated"])
```

### ✅ Sanity check — output vs input

```{r sanity_output}
violations <- family_sum %>% filter(n_output > n_input)
if (nrow(violations) > 0) {
  warning("Families with more detected than input:")
  print(violations %>% select(family, n_ncbi, n_input, n_output))
} else {
  message("✅ All detected counts <= input counts")
}

message(glue(
  "{sum(family_sum$n_input)} input | ",
  "{sum(family_sum$n_output)} detected | ",
  "{nrow(family_sum)} families | {n_phyla} phyla"
))

qc_lines <- c(
  glue("Figure 1A QC log \u2014 {Sys.time()}"),
  "---",
  glue("NCBI:     {NCBI_FILE}"),
  glue("FASTA:    {FASTA_FILE}"),
  glue("CSV:      {CSV_FILE}"),
  glue("Presence: {PRESENCE_FILE}"),
  glue("Peaks:    {PEAKS_FILE}"),
  "---",
  "Bar layer 1 (light grey): NCBI RefSeq complete genomes (capped at input)",
  "Bar layer 2 (dark grey):  accessions in >= 1 RppH-only (R) replicate",
  glue("  Total: {length(input_accs)}"),
  glue("Bar layer 3 (colour): unique accessions with >= {MIN_REPS} passing tiles"),
  "  Pass criteria: treated_sf >= 0.3, ctrl_sf <= 0.1, fold_change >= 3,",
  "  stall_reads >= 10, qvalue <= 0.01 (cutoffs applied in source xlsx)",
  glue("  Passing tiles:             {nrow(passing_tiles)}"),
  glue("  Unique accessions:         {nrow(det_accs)}"),
  glue("  treated_sf range (passing, best tile): ",
       "{round(min(all_tsf),4)} \u2013 {round(max(all_tsf),4)}"),
  glue("  qvalue range (passing, best tile):     ",
       "{signif(min(all_qval),3)} \u2013 {signif(max(all_qval),3)}"),
  "---",
  "Per-replicate presence counts:",
  capture.output(print(as.data.frame(rep_counts))),
  "---",
  "Presence category breakdown:",
  capture.output(print(as.data.frame(presence_summary)))
)
writeLines(qc_lines, OUT_QC)
message(glue("QC log -> {OUT_QC}"))
```

## 8. Colours and factor order

```{r colours_order}
phylum_colors <- c(
  "Pisuviricota"    = "#4472C4",
  "Kitrinoviricota" = "#C9542A",
  "Lenarviricota"   = "#70AD47",
  "Unannotated"     = "#999999"
)
rep_colors <- c(
  "2 replicates" = "#969696",
  "3 replicates" = "#252525"
)
region_colors <- c("3\u2032 UTR" = "#E07B54", "Intergenic" = "#6BAED6")

phylum_rank <- c("Pisuviricota"=1,"Kitrinoviricota"=2,
                 "Lenarviricota"=3,"Unannotated"=99)

fam_plot <- family_sum %>%
  mutate(phylum_idx = coalesce(phylum_rank[phylum], 50L)) %>%
  arrange(phylum_idx, n_input) %>%
  mutate(family = fct_inorder(factor(family)))

fam_levels <- levels(fam_plot$family)
n_fam      <- length(fam_levels)

add_phylum <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(family = factor(family, levels = fam_levels)) %>%
    left_join(fam_plot %>% select(family, phylum), by = "family") %>%
    filter(!is.na(family))
}

obs_utr  <- add_phylum(utr_joined) %>% mutate(region = "3\u2032 UTR")
obs_ig   <- add_phylum(ig_joined)  %>% mutate(region = "Intergenic")
obs_both <- bind_rows(obs_utr, obs_ig) %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c("3\u2032 UTR", "Intergenic")))
det_plot <- add_phylum(det_summary)
```

## 9. Shared theme

```{r theme}
theme_fig <- function(show_y = FALSE) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7.5) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y        = if (show_y)
                           element_text(size = 6.5, face = "italic",
                                        colour = "grey20", hjust = 1)
                         else element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y       = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 6, colour = "grey40"),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey40",
                                      margin = margin(t = 3)),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey94", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin        = margin(4, 2, 4, 2)
  )
}
```

## 10. Panel 1 — three-layer species count

```{r panel1}
max_n <- max(fam_plot$n_ncbi_capped, na.rm = TRUE)

phylum_brackets <- fam_plot %>%
  mutate(yi = as.integer(family)) %>%
  group_by(phylum) %>%
  summarise(y_lo  = min(yi) - 0.45, y_hi = max(yi) + 0.45,
            y_mid = mean(range(yi)), .groups = "drop")

p_count <- ggplot(fam_plot, aes(y = family)) +
  geom_col(aes(x = n_ncbi_capped), fill = "grey88", width = BAR_WIDTH) +
  geom_col(aes(x = n_input),       fill = "grey60", width = BAR_WIDTH) +
  geom_col(aes(x = n_output, fill = phylum), width = BAR_WIDTH,
           show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = phylum_brackets,
               aes(x = max_n * 1.06, xend = max_n * 1.06,
                   y = y_lo, yend = y_hi, colour = phylum),
               linewidth = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = phylum_brackets,
            aes(x = max_n * 1.20, y = y_mid, label = phylum, colour = phylum),
            angle = 90, size = 1.8, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold",
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = phylum_colors) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = fam_levels) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, max_n * 1.28),
                     breaks = pretty_breaks(4),
                     expand = expansion(0)) +
  labs(x = "Species count", y = NULL) +
  theme_fig(show_y = TRUE) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(4, 0, 4, 4))
```

---

## 11. Panel 2 — feature length distributions

```{r panel2}
p_lengths <- ggplot(obs_both, aes(y = family, x = length, fill = region)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(colour = region), outlier.shape = NA,
               width = BAR_WIDTH * 0.42, linewidth = 0.25,
               position = position_dodge(width = BAR_WIDTH),
               show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = region), shape = 16, size = 0.35, alpha = POINT_ALPHA,
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.height = 0.12,
                                             dodge.width = BAR_WIDTH),
             show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = region_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = region_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = fam_levels) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA),
                     breaks = c(0, 500, 1000, 1500),
                     labels = c("0", "500", "1,000", "1,500 nt"),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.03))) +
  labs(x = "Feature length (nt)", y = NULL) +
  guides(fill   = guide_legend(override.aes = list(colour = region_colors,
                                                    alpha = 1, shape = NA)),
         colour = "none") +
  theme_fig(show_y = FALSE) +
  theme(
    legend.position      = c(0.99, 0.02),
    legend.justification = c(1, 0),
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size      = unit(0.45, "lines"),
    legend.background    = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.85), colour = NA),
    legend.margin        = margin(2, 4, 2, 4)
  )
```

## 12. Panel 3 — detection by replicate

```{r panel3}
p_detect <- ggplot(det_plot, aes(y = family, x = n_accs, fill = rep_label)) +
  geom_col(width = BAR_WIDTH, position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rep_colors, name = "Passing replicates",
                    guide  = guide_legend(title.position = "top",
                                          reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = fam_levels) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
                     breaks = pretty_breaks(4)) +
  labs(x = "Accessions detected", y = NULL) +
  theme_fig(show_y = FALSE) +
  theme(
    legend.position      = c(0.99, 0.02),
    legend.justification = c(1, 0),
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title         = element_text(size = 6.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size      = unit(0.45, "lines"),
    legend.background    = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.85), colour = NA),
    legend.margin        = margin(2, 4, 2, 4)
  )
```

## 13. Assemble and save (PDF + SVG)

```{r assemble, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plots <- cowplot::align_plots(p_count, p_lengths, p_detect,
                              align = "v", axis = "lr")

fig <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  plots[[1]], plots[[2]], plots[[3]],
  nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1, 1.1, 0.75)
)

final <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_label(
    "+ssRNA virome library \u2014 family distribution, feature lengths, and detection",
    fontface = "bold", size = 9, x = 0.01, hjust = 0, colour = "grey10"),
  cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_label(
    glue(
      "{sum(family_sum$n_input)} accessions in RppH-only input  \u00b7  ",
      "{nrow(det_accs)} unique accessions detected ",
      "(\u2265{MIN_REPS} replicates passing)  \u00b7  ",
      "{nrow(family_sum)} families  \u00b7  {n_phyla} phyla"),
    size = 7, x = 0.01, hjust = 0, colour = "grey45"),
  fig,
  cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_label(
    glue(
      "Panel 1: light grey = NCBI RefSeq complete genomes (capped at input); ",
      "dark grey = accessions in \u2265 1 RppH-only (R) replicate; ",
      "colour = unique accessions with \u2265 {MIN_REPS} Xrn1 replicates passing ",
      "(treated_sf \u2265 0.3, ctrl_sf \u2264 0.1, fold_change \u2265 3, ",
      "stall_reads \u2265 10, qvalue \u2264 0.01; one count per accession). ",
      "Panel 2: 3\u2032UTR (orange) and intergenic (blue) feature lengths; ",
      "< {MIN_LEN} nt excluded. ",
      "Panel 3: unique detected accessions stacked by replicate reproducibility."),
    size = 6, x = 0.01, hjust = 0, colour = "grey55"),
  ncol        = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.035, 0.028, 1, 0.07)
)

# PDF
ggsave(OUT_PDF, final, width = FIGURE_W, height = FIGURE_H, device = cairo_pdf)
message("PDF -> ", OUT_PDF)

# SVG (Illustrator-ready)
svglite::svglite(OUT_SVG, width = FIGURE_W, height = FIGURE_H,
                 fix_text_size = FALSE)
print(final)
dev.off()
message("SVG -> ", OUT_SVG)

message("Summary   -> ", OUT_CSV)
message("Detection -> ", OUT_DET)
message("QC log    -> ", OUT_QC)
```
